title: The woodland post office
alt: A bespectacled hedgehog seals an envelope as a fox courier waits by the oak counter.
description: Pencil and watercolor distinguish the postmaster, courier and wax seal inside a hollow tree.
prompt: Watercolor picture-book illustration of a tiny hedgehog postmaster behind an oak counter inside the hollow trunk of a tree. The hedgehog wears little round spectacles and presses a red wax seal onto a cream envelope. A rust-coloured fox in a moss-green cape waits on the other side of the counter with a blue canvas mailbag. Pigeonholes cut into the curved wood hold folded letters, autumn leaves frame a round window, warm morning light, detailed pencil linework. The two animals have distinct bodies and expressions. No writing or human characters.
